title: What Is AI Evaluation?
description: Understand what AI evaluation is, why it matters, and how AI systems are tested.
introduction: AI evaluation is the process of systematically measuring whether an AI system behaves the way we expect it to.

blocks.text: An AI model can produce an answer that sounds convincing without actually being correct. Evaluation gives us a systematic way to determine whether the output meets the quality we expect.

blocks.label: KEY IDEA
blocks.text: A model being capable of producing an answer does not mean the answer is good. Evaluation is how we measure the difference.

blocks.label: SIMPLE EXAMPLE
blocks.text: Imagine asking an AI, 'What is the capital of France?' If it answers Paris, the response is factually correct. If it answers London, it has failed factuality even though the sentence may be perfectly fluent.

exercise.title: Your first evaluation
exercise.description: Take three AI responses and identify which responses are factually correct, relevant, complete, and instruction-following.
